stations.title: Files apart
stations.text: Prices and words, each with nowhere to go.

stations.title: One program
stations.text: Three files, one header, one main.

captions: At the end of the day Ambrose wants to know what the day's repairs come to.
His prices and Dorrit's words sit in separate files that nothing joins up.
You write each part in its own file and build all three into one program.
Now one program prices every repair from one place and adds up the day.
The workshop's program is built from several files now, around one header.
